applicant.title: ForiForeign — Applicant Guide
applicant.subtitle: From your CV to your new life abroad, step by step

items: Create your account at foriforeign.com → Start free. Choose Study abroad or Work abroad; you can change it any time.
Upload your CV first. Your profile fills itself: degrees with years, experience to the month, skills, languages, tests, licences. Check it under Profile → About me and add what is missing.
Your ForiForeign address (name@forimail.com) is created for you. Every application goes from it and every reply comes back to it. The email inside your CV is never used.
Profile → Documents is one vault. Drop files or tap the box; each file is read and filed automatically.
Must have for this case lists what the route needs, with instructions (passport bio page, degree certificate not marksheet…). Can strengthen your case lists optional extras.
Highest degree first; files not needed now are marked 'may be asked later'. Nothing is ever sent without your tap.
Opportunities searches 54 countries in both lanes. Type plain words: 'nurse germany', 'driver job canada', 'scholarship uk'. Typos and regions ('gulf', 'europe') are understood.
Every card shows verified facts: money (in USD and your currency), language needed, pathway (visa route → residence → PR), and for labour jobs the clearance you need before you fly.
Results never come back empty: if nothing exact exists, the search widens and tells you why. Partners with a signed MOU appear first among the options you qualify for, labelled.
Start case on a card. The case sheet shows a preparation checklist: eligibility, documents, CV, cover, requirements.
Review and send opens the preflight (six checks, estimated chance, employer fraud check). Send goes from your own ForiForeign address, in your own name.
Packages: Start, Smart, Premium. After an offer, one 'plus' payment covers the offer pack, visa desk, interview pack, arrival pack and a year of residence support. Prices show in your currency.
Mail opens on what needs you: interview invitations, offers, visa decisions. Every reply is read and classified.
Offers are recorded automatically with their conditions and deadlines; an interview pack is prepared from the posting and your CV.
Open the visa file from the case at offer stage; the route is chosen for you from the sourced rules. Six steps, appointments, tracking reference.

Status order: a decision in your mail counts first; if you check the portal yourself, tap Update status myself; only after the usual processing time does ForiForeign read your connected portal once. It never retries; it tells you to check.

Portal Assist: Connect & fetch status opens the portal in your browser with the Apply Assistant, fills your login, you complete any code or captcha, then one tap sends the status and a screenshot to your file.
Arrival plan with dated tasks; family checklist; residence counter and PR pathway under Profile → Options.
Drop the admission letter and fee receipt in the vault: they close the case and start your arrival plan.
No consultancy can see, add or contact you; your account cannot be attached to any consultancy. You pay ForiForeign only; official fees go directly to the authority.
Export or delete your data from Profile → Settings at any time.

faqs: Is searching free?
Yes. You pay only when a case is prepared and sent.
Which email do universities see?
Your ForiForeign address, in your name. Replies land in Mail.
Can you guarantee a visa?
No one honest can. You see an estimated chance with reasons.
I changed my mind about the lane.
Profile → Options → change lane. Nothing is lost.
A consultant says they manage my case.
Only if you signed up on their website. ForiForeign accounts are never handed to consultancies.

crm.title: FF-CRM — Staff and Owner Guide
crm.subtitle: The consultancy desk that also does the work

items: Staff and owners sign in at foriforeign.com/crm (or your own address /crm/your-name, shown under Team → Your door). The applicant landing never appears there.

Owners open the consultancy at /app#signup-agency; staff join only through the invite link the owner sends, with their own work email. A two-week trial on Starter limits starts automatically; the end date shows on the workspace.

Hard wall: you see your consultancy and your branch only; another consultancy can never see you; ForiForeign's direct applicants are never visible; our staff see your clients masked unless you grant support access for a set number of hours.
Add a client, import a CSV, or let leads arrive by themselves: your lead email address (leads.your-name@forimail.com), your own WhatsApp number with your own AI key, your website through the API.
Every client gets a ForiForeign address the moment the record is created; replies to it land on the client's screen and in your notifications.
Duplicates are caught by phone or email. Lost clients take a reason; reasons appear in the report. Follow-up sequences nudge silent leads on day 1, 3 and 7 and stop when the stage changes.
Search for a client from their profile: 54 countries, both lanes, verified postings, your own partner universities first (labelled Your partner · P1).
Prepare the full application in the client's name; send from the client's address; every reply is read. Review before send is mandatory: preflight, estimated chance, fraud check.
Bulk: Search for all shown, table view, CSV export. Quota per branch and per person under Team.
The client's vault with six states; expiry alerts; the reader files every upload.

Visa files per route with sourced rules, check-ins from the processing window, decisions read from mail. Status order: mail → your manual update → one automated read after the usual time → you are told to check.

Portal Assist on behalf: from the client's screen, Fetch visa status opens the portal in your browser with the Apply Assistant, you complete the security check, one tap sends the status and screenshot to the client's file.

Team → Your partner universities and employers: add or import your agreements (contact, fee, currency, payment days, agreement end, priority). They rank first for your clients; ForiForeign's outreach never approaches them.
Commissions are recorded against the partner and marked received with a date; enrolment evidence (admission number, fee receipt) stays on the client's file.
Fees and receipts per client; expenses by category and branch; disputes with a reference; bank accounts as records for your invoices.
P&L by branch and by month, clients and enrolments per branch, by consultant, lead sources, sub-agent payables. Your clients pay you; ForiForeign moves none of your money.
Roles: owner, manager, consultant, sub-agent, viewer. Branches and sub-branches with their own quota. Sub-agents see only their own clients.
White label (Growth and Scale): your name, logo, colour, address and domain on every screen and email; staff sign in with their own emails; clients sign up on your domain and belong to you.
Plans per consultancy, not per user. Reminders at 7, 3 and 0 days; 3 days of grace; renewal through the same checkout; a numbered invoice is emailed on every payment and listed under Billing.
API keys (Growth and Scale) under Team; webhooks for your own systems.

Help in the workspace opens this guide and the FAQs; Write to support creates a ticket routed to your consultancy's owner first and to ForiForeign when you mark it for us. Email: admin@foriforeign.com.

faqs: Can ForiForeign see my clients?
Masked by default. You can grant support access for a set number of hours; it is logged.
Can we add a person who already has a ForiForeign account?
No. FF-CRM is for clients you bring; the platform never links them.
Who collects the client's fees?
You do. FF-CRM records; it never moves your money.
Does the API cost extra?
It comes with Growth and Scale.
Can staff see other branches?
Only owners and managers; consultants and sub-agents see their own scope.
What happens when the plan lapses?
Three days of grace, then the workspace pauses; clients and files are kept.
